name: Smoked Polish Kielbasa (Tough Natural Casing WARNING)
whyItWorks: Stuffed into chewy, fibrous natural hog casing that resists mastication and stomach acid, presenting a mechanical obstruction risk against intestinal strictures. Seasoned with heavy minced garlic and black pepper, provoking painful gas.
prepOrOrderInstructions: AVOID during active disease. If eating in deep remission, peel and completely discard the outer casing before chewing.
